card.summary: H.R. 7432, the Fostering the Future Act, amends the Social Security Act to update and expand the John H. Chafee Foster Care Program for Successful Transition to Adulthood. The bill modifies federal funding and program rules to improve housing access, education, workforce training, legal counseling, and support services for current and former foster youth. It also requires federal agencies to issue joint guidance and report on housing outcomes, and updates the statutory purposes of the Chafee program regarding relationships, mentoring, and permanency planning.
